mapper.select: SELECT block_id, parent_block_id, task_id, event_id, sprint_id, image_file_id, type, position, content FROM blocks WHERE page_id = #{pageId} ORDER BY position, block_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blocks (page_id, task_id, event_id, sprint_id, image_file_id, type, position, content, created_by) VALUES (#{pageId}, #{taskId}, #{eventId}, #{sprintId}, #{imageFileId}, #{type}, #{position}, #{content}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT database_id, block_id, title, view_type FROM block_databases WHERE block_id = #{blockId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block_databases (block_id, title, view_type) VALUES (#{blockId}, #{title}, #{viewType})
mapper.select: SELECT column_id, database_id, name, type, position, width FROM block_database_columns WHERE database_id = #{databaseId} ORDER BY position, column_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block_database_columns (database_id, name, type, position, width) VALUES (#{databaseId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{position}, #{width})

INSERT INTO block_database_column_options (column_id, value, color, status_group, position) SELECT #{columnId}, value, color, status_group, position FROM block_database_column_options WHERE column_id = #{sourceColumnId}
mapper.select: SELECT row_id, database_id, page_id, position FROM block_database_rows WHERE database_id = #{databaseId} ORDER BY position, row_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block_database_rows (database_id, page_id, position) VALUES (#{databaseId}, #{pageId}, #{position})
